sources.notes: Points taken from Start/Finish Point placemarks in the organiser's 'Download Google Earth Maps' KMZ files (Shakedown, Day 1-3) linked from the official maps page. Placemark labels carry the stage numbers, so matching is unambiguous; each placemark is within 1-24 m of the corresponding end of the stage LineString. Missing: SSS1 'EKO SSS' (1.86 km, The Ellinikon, Athens) - not in any KMZ and no official start/finish GPS found. Shakedown (not a stage): KMZ 'SD_Start' 37.959862,23.033962 / 'SD_Finish' 37.959938,23.007661; SR 12.2.2 gives start 37°57.595' 23°02.031' (= 37.959917,23.03385), consistent. KMZ also contains liaison lines, refuel zones and spectator access roads (ignored). Route lines exist but are not to be reused (see reuse).
